subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

 'A+ B' means 'A is the sister of B'

 'A – B' means 'A is the brother of B'

 'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B'

 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

 Based on the above, how is M related to Q if 'M × N ÷ O + P − Q'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: M × N ÷ O + P − Q

M × N → M is the wife of N.

N ÷ O → N is the father of O.

O + P → O is the sister of P.

P − Q → P is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03ffacf136a34a2e72aca358ce7667eaf60b1380193f888d2ad0eec99d67d9ee.png] 

Thus, M is Q's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"
